title: Fair Prompt Design
design_principles: Identical project requirements for both runs
No Factory-specific instructions in vanilla prompt
No hidden context leaked between runs
Both runs start from clean session

run_a_vanilla.instructions: Standard Codex prompt — build InventoryOps Portal Lite from requirements. No Factory tools, gates, or policies available.

run_b_factory.instructions: Factory-assisted prompt — build InventoryOps Portal Lite using Build Lite workflow with all gates active.

fairness_checks.check: Same project requirements in both prompts
No Factory instructions in vanilla prompt
No hidden advantage for Factory run
Both prompts start from identical requirements text
